<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0022024-11-01-13-51" status="finalized">
                 <milestone n="lan gnyis pa: rgya" unit="section"/>
         <lb n="11.1"/> lan gnyis pa ni 'di <lb n="11.2"/> la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3834">rgya</rs> na re 
         <note type="gloss"><quote source="inst:4686" n="(ID:4685), 11a5"><lg><l>'di dag thams cad ma rungs pa ||</l> <l>rigs pa'i rnam dbye med pa'i skyon ||</l> <l>de phyir rnam <lb n="11.3"/> dbye shes par bya ||</l></lg></quote><note type="editorial">(ID:4685) has the variant "lhag ma 'di dag ma drungs ba'i" for the first line.</note> </note> 
         don dam dpyod pa'i rigs shes dang | tha snyad kun rdzob pa <lb n="11.4"/> 'jal ba'i tshad ma gnyis las 
         snga ma ni dgag bya la brtag bzod dpyad <lb n="11.5"/> bzod 'gegs la gzhal bya'ang brtag bzod dpyad bzod 'jal ba'o ||
      phyi ma <lb n="11.6"/> ni de las bzlog pa'o ||
      des na rim dang cig car gyis don byed pa bkag <lb n="11.7"/> pas dbang phyug rtag pa 'gog pa ni dgag bya dngos bo tsam zhes bya ba brtag <lb n="11.8"/> mi bzod dpyad mi bzod 'gegs pas dbang phyug rtag pa don dam du yod <lb n="11.9"/> pa'ang khegs la kun rdzob tsam du yod pa'ang khegs te tha snyad pa'i tshad ma <lb n="11.10"/> yin pas so ||
      cha med kyi gcig dang du ma bkag pas don dang shes pa 'gog <lb n="11.11"/> pa ni don dang shes pa don dam du yod pa zhes pa brtag bzod dpyad bzod <lb n="11.12"/> 'gegs pas don dang shes pa don dam du yod pa khegs kyi kun rdzob tu yod <lb n="11.13"/> pa mi khegs te tha snyad kun rdzob pa'i tshad ma ma yin pas so zhe'o ||</seg></TEI>
